title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Hard on Your Sin and Gentle With Everyone Else's
caption:
Most of us are soft on our own sin and sharp with the people closest to us. Jesus did the opposite.

Take the log out of your own eye first. Then go gently.

Send this to a brother who needs it.

#faith #godlyman #grace #humility #christianmen
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
